svg.title: Atome LM on RP2040
svg.desc: Atome weights are read from Flash by an inference task using Burn Flex and Rust loops. Embassy cooperatively schedules inference and a GPIO22 LED task on one core. RAM holds state and temporary buffers. defmt and RTT report inference metrics.

g.text: Baker link. Dev / RP2040 / Cortex-M0+ / no_std
SSM state / conv history / FP16 K/V
Cooperative scheduling: inference yields with await between blocks.
Each block is synchronous; LED timing is not guaranteed.
